Honoring the triage seat's serial constraint: **#8054 and #7968 also land in `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`** and are held out of this batch. #8055 goes first as the longer pole; the other two are queued behind it and will be dispatched once this lands.

Dispatch shape: mirror the sibling `/toggle` fix (#7535) — the catch arm must classify caller-input refusals as 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` with an ADR-0114 `details.fields[]`, not 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR`. Case 4 (the #4277 undeclared-config-key refusal) is the one that matters most: it already produces exactly the self-correcting message #4277 designed, delivered under a status that says the opposite. Case 1's raw zod issue array must stop reaching the wire — the house envelope belongs there.

⛔ Not licensed by this card: widening the refusal, softening any of the four refusals into a 200, or changing *which* bodies are rejected. Only the class and the envelope shape move. A contrast control that a well-formed body still registers 200 is part of the deliverable, not an optional extra.
